package mergerace_test

import (
	"github.com/pb33f/libopenapi"
	"testing"
)

func TestMergedComponents(t *testing.T) {
	const source = `openapi: 3.1.1
info: {title: Merge example, version: '1'}
paths: {}
x-base: &base
  schemas:
    Bound: {type: integer, minimum: 5, maximum: 10}
x-sources: &sources [*base]
components:
  <<: *sources
`
	document, err := libopenapi.NewDocument([]byte(source))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	model, err := document.BuildV3Model()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if model.Model.Components == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing components")
	}
	proxy, ok := model.Model.Components.Schemas.Get("Bound")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("missing merged schema")
	}
	schema := proxy.Schema()
	if schema == nil || schema.Minimum == nil || *schema.Minimum != 5 || schema.Maximum == nil || *schema.Maximum != 10 {
		t.Fatal("merged bounds changed")
	}
}
